transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
China opposes the US ban on DeepSeek in civilian federal agencies, citing politicization of the decision. Confirmed by Crypto Briefing.
Nvidia secured $35B in orders for its new export-compliant GPU from Chinese tech giants, exceeding production capacity. Confirmed by TradingView.
The Department of Homeland Security ordered DeepSeek removed from all federal IT systems due to security risks involving sensitive data. Confirmed by TechRepublic.
Anthropic is in talks with Nscale for a second multibillion-dollar data center deal valued at $45B. Still open, per CNBC.
Reliable Robotics, founded by a SpaceX alum, landed $115M in funding to certify autonomous flight technology with the FAA and airlines. Confirmed by TechCrunch.
Free every hour.
